findings.title: Early interpolation defeats $__range no-split guard
findings.body: runSplitQuery() now calls datasource.applyTemplateVariables() before querySupportsSplitting(). querySupportsSplitting() excludes queries where isQueryWithRangeVariable(query.expr) is true because $__range must be interpolated per split chunk on the backend. After up-front interpolation the expr no longer contains $__range, so the check never fires, the query is time-split, and every chunk keeps the full-range value baked in at line 296-300. The result is wrong $__range_s/$__range_ms values in split sub-queries.

findings.title: Queries interpolated twice on shard-split path
findings.body: runShardSplitQuery() interpolates with applyTemplateVariables at line 48-52 and then delegates each shard group to runSplitQuery(), which interpolates again at querySplitting.ts. The updated test expects 5 applyTemplateVariables calls for a single target (1 + 1 per shard group). This is redundant work that grows with shard count and time chunks, and risks double-expansion of non-idempotent variables.
